mapper.select: SELECT dimension, dim_value, metric, stat_value, source_dataset, stat_date FROM analysis_stat WHERE stat_date = (SELECT MAX(stat_date) FROM analysis_stat) ORDER BY dimension, dim_value

SELECT dimension, dim_value, metric, stat_value, source_dataset, stat_date FROM analysis_stat WHERE dimension = #{dimension} AND stat_date = (SELECT MAX(stat_date) FROM analysis_stat) ORDER BY stat_value DESC
SELECT skill, freq_count, source_dataset, stat_date FROM analysis_hot_skill WHERE stat_date = (SELECT MAX(stat_date) FROM analysis_hot_skill) ORDER BY freq_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(AVG((salary_min + salary_max) / 2.0), 0) FROM job WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(match_score), 0) FROM application WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT create_time FROM job WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time
SELECT delivery_time FROM application WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY delivery_time
